# Wolf Contractor

> Website design and local SEO for home service and trades businesses in the US and Canada.

Wolf Contractor builds fast, mobile-first websites and runs local SEO for contractors:
window cleaning, pressure washing, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, painting,
remodeling, general contracting and commercial services.

## What we do
- Custom trade websites built to convert visitors into booked jobs
- Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization for map pack visibility
- Google Ads management for home service businesses
- Lead generation funnels and follow-up automation
- Managed hosting and site speed optimization
- Content and photography for contractor websites

## How we work
- We researched 700+ home service websites before building our process
- Every build is measured on calls and form fills, not page views
- No long-term contracts

## Packages
- Launchpad — $2,900 one-time
- Workhorse — $4,900 one-time
- Overdrive — $7,900 one-time
